signals.summary: Hyrox, the functional-fitness race format, continuing its global spread — from Germany to Chinese and Chinese-pensioner participants. Serve it through the rig, sleds, wall balls and arena rather than faces.
signals.why_now: Multiple outlets over the week (DW 'how Germany's Hyrox became a global craze' 76h, Times 'Chinese pensioners jump to Hyrox' 98h, ABC/Yahoo explainers 219h). Reddit fitness feeds were down (429) this run.

signals.summary: Calm, restorative movement framed as ritual — grounding morning yoga, legs-up-the-wall for sleep, gentle mobility. Lead with the mat, the light and the studio; environment-and-object led, not body led.
signals.why_now: Yoga With Adriene's restorative catalogue plus senior-mobility news over the fortnight (Start the Day Grounded, Legs Up The Wall for sleep, mobility exercises for aging well). Evergreen, on-category.

signals.summary: Short, scattered bursts of movement — 'exercise snacks', jugwalking, three-minute routines — framed as fitness for people who dislike the gym. Producible through settings, stairs and everyday objects rather than bodies.
signals.why_now: Several outlets within the week ('What Are Exercise Snacks?' 40.6h, 'Jugwalking' 61.5h, '3-minute exercise better than 90-minute one' 143.9h). A coherent micro-movement framing across sources.
